purpose: Screening of two candidate methods (DCBC, QDCBC) against T, BC and BCMIX re-run on the same machine with the same new seeds. Registered in research/PLAN.md (auto-loop branch) before submission.

rule.metric: Last5 = mean of the last five evaluation points, 10 episodes each (V21 metric)
rule.strong_control: per task, the group among T, BC, BCMIX with the highest Last5 mean over seeds 3001-3005
rule.screen_effective: candidate minus strong control, paired by seed: mean > 0 and mean > 1 * paired SE
rule.supported: screen-effective on at least 2 of the 3 tasks -> a confirmation job with 5 never-used seeds per task on those tasks
rule.rejected: paired mean difference <= 0 on at least 2 of the 3 tasks
rule.descriptive: 2 * SE criterion, candidate minus BCMIX and minus BC, DCBC vs QDCBC, episode lengths
rule.note: Rules are fixed before results; not changed after results are seen.
